description: Shows the total amount of an item in your inventory when collecting resources
readme:
# PopupTotals A mod to show the total amount of an item in your inventory while collecting resources
Examples
### Installation - Install [BepInEx](https://v-rising.thunderstore.io/package/BepInEx/BepInExPack_V_Rising/) - Install using your preferred Thunderstore mod monger. To install manually, extract _PopupTotals.dll_ into _(VRising folder)/BepInEx/plugins_ ### Known Issues - None ([report one?](https://github.com/matt-harp/PopupTotals)) ### Support Join the [modding community](https://discord.gg/CWzkHvekg3) for support `@Night#3605` Post an issue on the [github repo](https://github.com/matt-harp/PopupTotals)
